meta.name: probe_g38_3_4_5_refused_typed_and_in_file
meta.description: 51.27 and 51.292 probe only on G38.2: any other G38 word prints `G38.n is invalid. Only G38.2 recognized.` and acks `ok` with no move and no `z axis zeroed` (holey GCode.cpp G38), so a file that relies on it would cut from a Z that was never set. Typed, G38.3 and G38.5 are refused with an alert and the lines after them still go; in a file, G38.4 pauses the job before it with an alert, as an unclosed comment does. Python sent them.
